018package org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.client;
019
020import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
021
022import javax.management.Notification;
023import java.util.Optional;
024
025import org.apiguardian.api.API;
026import org.tquadrat.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
027
028/**
029 *  <p>{@summary An implementation of
030 *  {@link PerfLogClientBase}.}</p>
031 *  <p>This class provides a simple API for a client for the Foundation
032 *  Performance Logging and Monitoring. Basically, this is a recipient for the
033 *  {@link Notification}
034 *  messages that are sent each time a
035 *  {@linkplain org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.PerformanceSection performance
036 *  section} was left.</p>
037 *
038 *  @extauthor Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
039 *  @version $Id: PerfLogClientSupport.java 1207 2026-04-24 21:50:11Z tquadrat $
040 *  @since 0.25.0
041 *
042 *  @UMLGraph.link
043 */
044@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: PerfLogClientSupport.java 1207 2026-04-24 21:50:11Z tquadrat $" )
045@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.25.0" )
046public final class PerfLogClientSupport extends PerfLogClientBase
047{
048        /*--------------*\
049    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
050        \*--------------*/
051    /**
052     *  Creates a new instance of {@code PerfLogClientSupport}.
053     */
054    public PerfLogClientSupport()
055    {
056        super();
057    }   //  PerfLogClientSupport()
058
059        /*---------*\
060    ====** Methods **==========================================================
061        \*---------*/
062    /**
063     *  Waits for an incoming message.
064     *
065     *  @return The message.
066     *  @throws InterruptedException    An interrupt occurred while waiting.
067     */
068    public final String awaitMessage() throws InterruptedException
069    {
070        final var retValue = getQueue().take();
071
072        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
073        return retValue;
074    }   //  awaitMessage()
075
076    /**
077     *  <p>{@summary Pulls an incoming message.}</p>
078     *  <p>Returns
079     *  {@linkplain Optional#empty() emtpy}
080     *  if there is currently no message.</p>
081     *
082     *  @return An instance of
083     *      {@link Optional}
084     *      that holds the message.
085     */
086    public final Optional<String> retrieveMessage()
087    {
088        final var retValue = Optional.ofNullable( getQueue().poll() );
089
090        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
091        return retValue;
092    }   //  retrieveMessage()
093}
094//  class PerfLogClientSupport
095
096/*
097 *  End of File
098 */
